text:
sam: Planning a compact rack-level sweep with Nimbus next week. Focus: watt-per-token, end-to-end tokens/s, and one kernel tuning pass in their lab. Need matrix + minimal telemetry + owners.

nina: +1. Minimal matrix: redwood-3b and redwood-7b, quants fp16/int8, batch sizes 1 and 4, seq 512. Keep runs=3. Capture rack_power_w and gpu_power_w.

charles: I'll own the runbook. Suggest command flag `--pdu-scan` to capture per-PDU channels and `--kv-flush` option between iters. Example:
```
./bench --model redwood-7b --batch 4 --seq 512 --quant int8 --runs 3 --pdu-scan --out s3://partners/nimbus/3487654321/
```

yuki: I'll update exporter labels: lab, rack, pdu, model, quant, run_id. Metrics: rack_power_w, gpu_power_w, tokens_total, p95_ms, peak_kv_bytes. Add PromQL for energy/token: `sum(rate(rack_power_w[1m]))/sum(rate(tokens_total[1m]))`.

sam: Nimbus requires kernel blobs to remain in their environment; legal confirmed coop NDA. They want a one-page tech annex and a rollback checklist.

bench-bot: CI smoke: 3 runs attempted; 1 transient PDU read error on run 1. Logs at s3://bench/nimbus/3487654321/logs.tar.gz.

nina: I'll draft telemetry CSV columns and push to GH issue today: model,batch,seq,quant,avg_gpu_w,rack_w,tokens_s,p95_ms,energy_j_per_token,peak_kv_bytes,run_id.

charles: I'll include a short section in the runbook about PDU retries and safe kernel rollback commands for partner lab only. Will open PR and tag infra.

yuki: I'll add the Prom exporter changes tomorrow AM and include a short example query in the runbook.

sam: Action items assigned. Weekly sync set for Friday 3487654981 to decide canary timing and marketing blurb. Thanks all.

bench-bot: Created issue #6340 "Nimbus rack sweep: matrix + telemetry + annex" and scheduled weekly sync Friday 3487654981.
